Use case: precise-object-edit / background extraction.
Input image is the approved Home reference. Create ONE isolated game prop: only the small wooden fantasy training ring at the left rear of the room.
Reconstruct that exact ring as complete unobstructed artwork, including portions hidden behind the character. Preserve the original shallow three-quarter perspective with a broad nearly horizontal front edge, visible right side, and high back ropes. It is a rectangular raised warm dark timber platform with oxblood-red training mat, subtle aged-gold edge trim, dark iron corner brackets and bolts, FOUR corner posts with red padded upper sections, and exactly THREE continuous parallel tan ropes around all four sides connected convincingly to the posts. No extra middle posts, broken ropes, floating attachments or stairs.
Match its rustic fantasy pixel-art palette and materials; this is a compact training prop, not a large stadium. Keep the same low perspective from the reference, do not turn it into a steep isometric diamond.
Output one complete ring centered, generously padded, on a REAL transparent RGBA background. Keep transparent air between the ropes and around the platform. No background room, ground/floor, character, bag, furniture, plant, title, text, UI or contact sheet. No cast shadow extending beyond the prop; its timber base supplies the floor contact. Use a landscape 1536x1024 canvas, ring occupies most of the width and roughly the middle half-height. Single object only.

Edit this single training ring asset. Keep its exact four posts, platform, red mat, wood, iron trim, framing, size, perspective and pixel style. Correct the ropes: there must be THREE distinct ropes on EACH of the four sides, an upper, middle and lower rope. Currently the ring has only two levels. Add the missing lower ropes about one-third of the post height above the mat, with matching attachment points and consistent perspective; no diagonals crossing through the mat, no extra posts. Replace the entire brown/black gradient backdrop with solid uniform white, including all empty air between the ropes and posts. No cast ground shadow. One isolated complete ring on plain white, no text or other objects. Do not change the camera or make the platform taller.
autospriteShortDescription: Rustic fantasy training ring; red mat, timber platform, iron brackets, four padded posts, three tan ropes per side. Single prop. Preserve camera, floor footprint and pivot.
